sn10.3:1.2: “Shaggy” is _khara_ and “Spiky” is _sūciloma_, literally “needle-hair”. _Yakkha_ is a general name for a local spirit, and they may be of many kinds. There are sculptures of _yakkhas_ who are magnificent kings or warriors. This pair, on the other hand, are more like grotesque demons (_rakkhasas_). _Khara_ is found for a number of demons in Sanskrit. We don’t find _suciloma_, but compare the demons Khara and his twin sister, the ugly and mutilated twin sister Śūrpaṇakhā (“wicker-nails”).
sn10.3:2.8: Considering the Ganges is 100 km away, this is even more impressive!
